09

AI 场景 AI Scenarios

Ten scenario cards, three test scenarios, five personas. What separates a test from an application is that a test must have a failure criterion.
  • Segmented lighting rhythm
  • Irrigation window avoidance
  • Defect assignment and rejection
  • Plant inspection and adoption
  • Slow-mobility discontinuity notice
  • Public-space test registration
  • Heritage node interpretation
  • Milepost wayfinding
  • Open maintenance data
  • Agent action logging
Test scenarioFailure criterion
Segmented lighting validationA fall in perceived night safety is failure
Cross-segment work-order validationA rejection rate near zero is failure
Anonymous granularity validationIf none passes reidentification assessment, the data should not be collected
P2 data boundary: assets not people — no location, duration ranking or efficiency profiling

假设与限制 Assumptions

This section records what the proposal does not know and which conclusions the gaps affect.
A-CONTROLS-001Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments b
A-BOUNDARY-001三层范围几何均派生自仓库 provisional_boundaries.geojson，六个要素 official_boundary 均为 false，boundary_precision 为 provisional_rough。独立复算面积为统筹 43.61、总体 11.41、三重点区合计 3.6
A-INTENSITY-001容积率、建筑规模、建筑高度、拆改留、道路红线与开发时序均属法定规划判断，边界条款明令 agent 不得结论化。
A-FIGURES-001部分案例数字仅有单一或二手来源：高线公园运营成本与资金比例为中文二手转述、肯德尔广场 5% 创新空间来自 MIT 校友刊物、清华园车站为通车后添置的三等小站。
A-HISTORY-001京张铁路 1909 年通车的具体日期与典礼地点各家权威来源互相矛盾（9 月 24 日 / 10 月 2 日；张家口 / 西直门 / 南口）。
A-TRADEMARK-001标识方案的道钉截面取形是否与既有商标重合，无检索能力，风险无法排除。
A-COORDINATION-001三个朝圣地标分属不同养路段与不同主管方；跨段工单、运维数据公开均需要一个跨段统筹角色，现行体制中无对应主体。
